Standard suit prices are available for Cotton, Polyester, Wool / Star and Super / Americano. Star is the usual women’s option in the Wool collection; Americano is the usual women’s option in the Super collection. Alternative fabrics and special work require a quotation. Collection names do not establish exact fabric composition; Super is a supplied fabric name, not proof of composition. Standard prices apply to standard designs, sizes and production. Extra fabric, embroidery, decorations, special construction and other special requirements receive an agreed quotation. Confirm the complete applicable price and extras before payment. Reference-photo details depend on fabric availability and design feasibility.

Included with your suit

A two-piece suit includes a jacket/coat and trousers. A three-piece suit includes a jacket/coat, trousers and waistcoat. A full-set package may add a shirt and necktie; neither is automatically included in the standard suit price. Skirt-suit requests require a separate quotation and confirmation. The standard suit package includes the agreed suit and standard tailoring, a branded hanger and protective cover, one initial standard professional cleaning, and initial door-to-door delivery within Kigali. These included items are not charged separately again.

Returning purchases and suit benefits

Receive 3% off suits from your third separate qualifying purchase, including that third purchase and future qualifying suit purchases. Several suits bought together count as one purchase toward the milestone. The benefit applies to suits only, not alterations, garment care, standalone items, separately priced accessories or optional-service charges. Cotton and Polyester include the initial suit cleaning only, with no complimentary follow-up cleaning. Wool / Star and Super / Americano include three shared standard cleaning occasions in total. Initial cleaning before handover uses occasion one; two follow-up occasions remain within three months starting at initial handover. A shirt bought with, or eligible gifted alongside, the qualifying suit shares the same counter.
